title: Sherman accounts of orbs and giant wolf-like creatures heading toward Dry Gulch Creek
place_text: Dry Gulch Creek, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah

tellings.quote: There had been accounts, in fact, going back to the Shermans, accounts of orbs of light traveling that direction or and and even these giant wolves, wolf-like creatures that it proceeded to head out toward that part of the ranch and disappeared.

plain: In the 1990s, orbs of light and giant wolf-like creatures were reportedly seen heading toward the Dry Gulch Creek area of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, where they disappeared. Brandon Fugal, who now owns the ranch, passes on these accounts, which he says go back to the Shermans, a family who lived there earlier.
